label: Animals
notes: P state possibly facultatively colonial (choanoflagellate-like). Metazoa root = Porifera/Ctenophora/ParaHoxozoa polytomy: run sponge-first and ctenophore-first variants

label: Choanoflagellate colonies
notes: grey zone; coloniality scattered in Craspedida, no defensible internal origin node: tip-level only
eligibility_reason: grey-zone state; M is not a single clade

label: Capsaspora aggregation
notes: single species; aggregative stage is a culture phenotype

label: Ichthyosporea/Teretosporea coenocytes
notes: coenocytic development likely ancestral to Teretosporea (Corallochytrium coenocytic stage): P and M share the state; excluded from primary tests

label: Fungal hyphae
notes: D7 (audit F2): Kiss et al. 2019 place hyphae at Zoopagomycota+Dikarya (=Amastigomycota here) and treat Blastocladiomycota as mostly unicellular; the stem is the 2-edge path from Eumycota. Allomyces (hyphal blastoclad) is a separate exploratory origin.

label: Gonapodya hyphae
notes: separate tip origin of hyphae within Chytridiomyceta

label: Pezizomycotina fruiting bodies
notes: P (saccharomyceta) is hyphal; Saccharomycotina = reversal (Nagy et al. 2014), not a unicellular sister

label: Agaricomycete fruiting bodies
notes: M = Agaricomycetes + Dacrymycetes; Tremellomycetes possibly a separate origin (sensitivity: T_fungi_tremella); Cryptococcus = reversal

label: Tremella jelly fruiting body
notes: sensitivity coding (separate Tremellomycetes origin)

label: Neolecta fruiting body
notes: tip; BUSCO-limited; Taphrinomycotina internal order unresolved (polytomy)

label: Saccharomycotina yeasts
notes: reversal to yeast growth (Yarrowia still dimorphic)

label: Fission yeast
notes: tip reversal; P is a polytomy

label: Saitoella yeast
notes: tip reversal; P is a polytomy

label: Cryptococcus yeast
notes: tip reversal (dimorphic in sexual cycle)

label: Rhodotorula yeast
notes: tip reversal; ancestral state of Pucciniomycotina debated

label: Zygnematophyceae unicells
notes: all three sampled zygnematophytes are unicellular; filamentous Zygnematophyceae (Zygnema, Spirogyra) unsampled, so the node-level reversal is a sampling-dependent simplification

label: Dictyostelid sorocarps
notes: aggregative SIMPLE (Knoll 2011); Physarum (sister clade) is coenocytic/grey

label: Physarum plasmodium
notes: grey zone; transcriptome
eligibility_reason: grey-zone state; single multicellular species; <2 sister species

label: Fonticula sorocarp
notes: single tip; Nuclearia unavailable, Parvularia (transcriptome) is the sister

label: Acrasis sorocarp
notes: P (Tetramitia) is a polytomy: Acrasis / Neovahlkampfia / Naegleriidae

label: Copromyxa sorocarp
notes: transcriptome; sister within Tubulinea contested (Brown et al. 2011); P is a polytomy

label: Guttulinopsis sorocarp
notes: presence-only (transcriptome BUSCO ~11%)

label: Volvocine origin 1 (Tetrabaenaceae)
notes: Lindsey et al. 2021: Tetrabaenaceae arose independently (unsampled unicellular sister); P = TGV_clade inferred unicellular
eligibility_reason: single multicellular species; superseded by T_volvocine_tgv (D4)

label: Volvocine origin 2 (Gonium + Volvocaceae)
notes: Goniaceae paraphyletic (Lindsey et al. 2021); germ-soma differentiation arose >=4 times inside (Volvox, Pleodorina): coded "differentiated" at species level, not complex

label: Streptophyte multicellularity
notes: Chlorokybus packets make P grey; Zygnematophyceae inside M are reversals

label: Land plants
notes: nested S->X; P = Zygnematophyceae + Embryophyta

label: Chara
notes: tip S->X

label: Red algal multicellularity (Eurhodophytina)
notes: Stylonematophyceae/Compsopogonophyceae filaments = independent origins (not sampled as MC); Bangiales low BUSCO

label: Florideophyceae
notes: nested S->X; all sampled florideophytes are Rhodymeniophycidae

label: PX-clade filaments
notes: filaments predate Phaeophyceae (Schizocladia, Phaeothamnion, Tribonema filamentous); P = Ochrophyta polytomy (incl. Raphidophyceae); Xanthophyceae also contain unicells
eligibility_reason: meets DESIGN §2 rule; caveat: filamentous state of the PX ancestor is inferred (evo_biology.md review)

label: Brown algae
notes: nested S->X; Discosporangium and Ectocarpus are filamentous (coded simple); sensitivity M = Dictyotophycidae_Fucophycidae

label: Xanthophyceae
notes: subsumed by T_px_filaments; Vaucheria siphonous (grey)

label: Ulva
notes: no single Ulvophyceae M (Del Cortona et al. 2020); Ulva tip only

label: Bryopsidales siphons
notes: grey zone (giant coenocytes)

label: Oomycete hyphae
notes: grey; hyphochytrid sisters unsampled (no proteome); P = Gyrista

label: Plasmodiophora plasmodium
notes: grey; P = Rhizaria polytomy

label: Labyrinthula ectoplasmic nets
notes: grey zone

label: Sorogena sorocarp
notes: no sequence data for Sorogena; Platyophrya kept as background

label: Sorodiplophrys sorocarp
notes: no sequence data; labyrinthulids kept as background

label: Filamentous cyanobacteria
notes: MRCA of filamentous taxa = all non-Gloeobacter cyanobacteria: contains unicellular taxa (multicellularity early with reversals, Schirrmeister et al. 2011/2013, or multiple origins)

label: Heterocystous cyanobacteria
notes: P = Nostocales + Chroococcidiopsis; P state uncertain (Chroococcidiopsis baeocytous/unicellular)

label: True-branching cyanobacteria
notes: tips; MRCA = Nostocales polytomy
eligibility_reason: M is not a single clade

label: Myxobacterial fruiting bodies
notes: M = Myxococcota contains non-fruiting Anaeromyxobacter and Vulgatibacter (losses or independent gains); P = Pseudomonadati polytomy

label: Streptomycete mycelium
notes: P = Actinomycetes polytomy; other mycelial actinomycetes (Frankia, Micromonospora, ...) suggest mycelium may be ancestral to Actinomycetes with losses

label: Other mycelial actinomycetes
notes: tips; no clade
eligibility_reason: M is not a single clade

label: Multicellular magnetotactic bacteria
notes: metagenomic drafts; MRCA = Desulfobacterales contains unicellular taxa

label: Cable bacteria
notes: Electrothrix + Electronema

label: Jeongeupia sacculi
notes: tip; P = Jeongeupia (polytomy of 3)

label: Haloferax tissue-like growth
notes: single species; condition-dependent

label: Archaeal filaments
notes: tips
eligibility_reason: grey-zone state; M is not a single clade

label: Volvocine colonial lineage (Gonium+Volvocaceae; path stem from Chlamydomonas_TGV)
notes: D7 (audit F1): Lindsey et al. 2021 find colonial volvocines non-monophyletic, so TGV_clade is inferred unicellular and exists only through Tetrabaena (BUSCO 32%); the stem is the 2-edge path Chlamydomonas_TGV>TGV_clade>Gonium_Volvocaceae. Tetrabaena = separate exploratory origin.
